source.name: Variational Omni public statistics API
source.volume_window: Rolling 24 hours, not a UTC calendar-day total
source.trader_oi_calculation: Reported v2 double-sided OI divided by two; returned-listing sums are tracked separately and may have partial coverage
source.market_oi_scope: Trader long plus short positions; OLP mirror positions excluded
source.quote_status: Indicative; not executed trades or an order book
source.quote_notional_convention: Source dollar-notional convention; no currency conversion inferred
source.full_spread_formula: (ask - bid) / ((ask + bid) / 2) * 10000; midpoint convention, rounded to 12 decimal places
source.funding: Source annualized and interval rates retained separately. Swap long/short financing is not perpetual funding.

totals.trader_open_interest_basis: Reported v2 double-sided open interest divided by two
